titulo: Trump says he’ll probably lose lawsuit brought by news outlets he banned from White House, blaming judge appointed by ‘TRUMP’ – as it happened
cuerpo: This live blog is now closed. US TV networks suspend White House pool coverage over Trump media ban Sign up for US Breaking News emails The three news outlets President Trump banned from the White House last Friday have filed their anticipated lawsuit against his administration to restore their access. In the new complaint filed in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia on Monday, CNN, MS Now and Politico alleged that Trump had violated the First Amendment and due process by stripping the outlets of their White House access in a blatant act of retaliation for coverage he disliked.
